Class MoneyWeightedReturn

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.common.MoneyWeightedReturn
public final class MoneyWeightedReturn extends Object
Money-weighted return of a period, that is the internal rate of return of the investor's own money on the booked dates of the flows.

From the investor's point of view the opening value is paid at t = 0, every deposit is paid and every withdrawal received on its day, and the closing value is received at t = T. The rate s is the logarithmic return over the whole period and solves 

f(s) = Σ CF_j × exp(−s × t_j / T) = 0

Scaling the time to t / T keeps every exponent within [−20, 20]. Instead of a Newton iteration, which may run to an arbitrary one of several roots, the function is sampled on a grid and only a single sign change is refined by bisection. Several or no sign changes are reported by their MoneyWeightedReturnStatus instead of a number. Two roots closer than the grid step of 0.01 in s are not detected.

    • solve

      public static MoneyWeightedReturn.Result solve(LocalDate start, double startValue, LocalDate end, double endValue, List<MoneyWeightedReturn.DatedFlow> flows)
      Searches the internal rate of return of a period.
      Parameters:
      start - first date of the period, the opening value is valued at its end
      startValue - value on the start date
      end - last date of the period
      endValue - value on the end date
      flows - external flows; only those dated after start and not after end are taken
      Returns:
      the status and, when calculated, the logarithmic return of the period
